Custom Racing Bicycles & The Rodriguez Outlaw™
Outlaw™ Image Galleries
Full bike as light as 13.5 pounds
Rodriguez Outlaw™ - World's Lightest Road Bike
Be kind to yourself with a hand crafted steel bike that's lighter, faster, guaranteed for life, and rides more comfortably than any carbon bike. The Outlaw™ is the high performance choice for those of us who want to enjoy the ride as well as get there quickly.
• Fast - Lighter than carbon bikes
• Ride Longer - More comfortable than carbon
• The Perfect Fit - It's just your size!
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• Anything else....Just ask!
Race bikes from $4,999
Rodriguez Outlaw™ Ultra-light Steel Bicycles - The comfortable choice
Do you need a carbon fiber frame to get your bike weight down to 14 pounds? Most people think so. There are two types of people. Those who believe what's written in a magazine, and those who want to see for themselves. Read On...
Paint and Decals Contact Us
Photo Gallery Sizing Information
Testimonials How to Order
Yes! We ship bikes anywhere.
6 year old, 39 pound Grace, lifting the Rodriguez Outlaw
Grace, still holding the bike while my cheap digital camera warms up for another shot.
Contact us Sorry professional racers, some of our Outlaw bicycles have been banned by the UCI. It's considered an unfair advantage to race a bicycle this light! The Outlaw is the flagship model of our steel racing bikes. The cost and specifications for this bike are competitive with the big guys too! Even though our bicycle is hand made just for you, right here in Seattle and theirs are mass produced overseas. This year, we're also offering this model with a wide tire/fender option for those who would like that.
Nothin' Up Our Sleeve
The Outlaw uses no 'tricks' to get the bicycle weight down. Every component selected is un-modified and ready to ride. The published weights are true and verified. The bicycles weighed were a medium size equivalent to a 54~55cm frame, and were weighed with (13.8) (and without (13.5)) Speedplay ti X1 pedals and a Serfas carbon bottle cage. The frame weight listed includes the bottom bracket shell, head tube and the dropouts (unlike many carbon manufacturers). There are no proprietary components (forks or bottom brackets) that make the frame lighter, but add all the saved weight back when the bike is assembled for riding. A sub-14 pound bike is not the bike for every rider. Your weight, height, component choices, and riding style all affect the end weight of your perfect 'light' bike. If weight is really important to you, let's talk about your needs, wants and price range. We'll come up with a weight that we can guarantee for you with those in mind.
